body.name: Occupancy-normalized pair score
body.construction: Set \(U_i=2A_i-1\), \(V_i=2Y_i-1\), and \(Z_{ir}=(U_iV_r+V_iU_r)/2\). For each public core \(C_j\), let \(B_j=0\) when \(N_j<2\), and otherwise let \(B_j=\{N_j(N_j-1)\}^{-1}\sum_{i\ne r:X_i,X_r\in C_j}Z_{ir}\). Define \(S_{\mathrm{pair}}=\sum_{j=1}^kB_j\).
